sources.title: Sortie README
sources.locator: The Problem; Works With; Install; How It Works
sources.finding: Open-source orchestrator that runs Claude Code, Copilot, OpenCode, Codex, Kiro and Gemini on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Linear and Jira issues in parallel on your own machine or server; WORKFLOW.md config; CI and review feedback; dashboard, JSON API, Prometheus; single binary, no database to deploy, no telemetry.

sources.title: WORKFLOW.md reference
sources.finding: Limits (max_concurrent_agents, max_turns, max_sessions, max_tokens, max_cost_usd, daily/weekly/monthly cost), timeouts, retry backoff, dispatch rules and stage chains, reactions, self-review, notifications.

sources.title: Dashboard reference
sources.locator: Security; Overview; Pipeline; Actions; Attention items
sources.finding: Browser dashboard with Overview, Pipeline, History, Analytics, Health, Workflow, Prices; attention items, Acknowledge, Retry now and Check now actions; no authentication; default loopback bind.

sources.title: HTTP API reference
sources.finding: JSON API (state, runs, stats, prices, issue detail, events stream, reactions), health probes and Prometheus metrics on one port without authentication.

sources.title: CLI reference
sources.finding: sortie daemon with --once, --dry-run, --port, --host; subcommands validate, stats and mcp-server.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.finding: Single static Go binary; SQLite (pure Go) as the only storage; no Postgres, Redis or queue.

sources.title: Isolation
sources.finding: Per-issue workspace directory, empty by default with lifecycle hooks; path containment, name sanitization and symlink rejection are enforced; git is operator-provided via hooks.

sources.title: Security model
sources.locator: Workspace isolation; prompt injection surface; comments
sources.finding: Sortie owns workspace invariants; agent sandboxes are passed through to each agent; no prompt filtering; query_filter restricts what reaches the agent; comment feed defaults to write-access authors.

sources.title: Persistence
sources.finding: SQLite stores retry entries with due_at, run history and counters, so restarts resume state.

sources.title: Spend measurement
sources.locator: Where a figure comes from; completeness
sources.finding: Costs are built from what each agent reports locally (live and records sources), recorded as complete or lower_bound, estimated at API prices; Sortie never asks the provider for a bill.

sources.title: Agent tools
sources.finding: Agents get Sortie MCP tools: sortie_status, cost_budget, run history and tracker passthrough scoped to the configured project.

sources.title: Stage chains
sources.locator: A stage is a dispatch rule
sources.finding: Dispatch rules can be chained with next and stage labels so an issue moves from step to step automatically.

sources.title: Control costs
sources.finding: Per-issue session, token and dollar limits, instance daily/weekly/monthly dollar limits, turn and concurrency limits; only claude-code has a per-turn money cap.

sources.title: Schedule agent work
sources.finding: Sortie has no internal scheduler; recurring work is done by creating tracker issues from the tracker or CI scheduler.

sources.title: Scale agents with SSH
sources.finding: Agent sessions can run on a pool of remote POSIX hosts over SSH; the orchestrator can run on any platform including Windows.

sources.title: Configure CI feedback
sources.finding: Off by default; failed CI on an agent branch is fed back to the agent via GitHub, Gitea or GitLab status; escalation after max retries.

sources.title: Configure review feedback
sources.finding: Request-changes reviews and inline comments on a Sortie PR are routed back to the agent; off by default.

sources.title: Steer agents with issue comments
sources.finding: Issue comments reach the agent at the start of its next turn; no interruption of a running turn.

sources.title: Use label commands
sources.finding: Labels sortie:review and sortie:fix on a PR dispatch a read-only review or a fix session.

sources.title: Check issue readiness
sources.finding: A cheap first-stage rule can park unready issues before the main run.

sources.title: Use subagents
sources.finding: Sub-agent definition files in the repository are discovered by the agent runtime; Sortie does not route them.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)
sources.finding: Repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0.

sources.title: GitHub API for sortie-ai/sortie
sources.finding: Repository has 224 stars, license Apache-2.0, homepage sortie-ai.com, last push 2026-11-16.

sources.title: Sortie v1.32.0 release
sources.finding: v1.32.0 (2026-11-10) has 13 assets: macOS and Linux tarballs for amd64 and arm64, Windows zips for amd64 and arm64, SBOMs and checksums; v1.30.0, v1.31.0 and v1.32.0 shipped weekly.

sources.title: Notification backends
sources.finding: Outbound notifier backends for Slack, Discord, generic webhooks and Telegram; no inbound webhook receiver found.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.finding: No telemetry client; matches are a Windows process-capture comment, a Copilot parser and a fake model fixture. README states Sortie itself sends no telemetry.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: No users, roles, SSO or presence; the HTTP server has no authentication.

sources.title: Bounded search: PR creation and merge
sources.finding: The scm packages read PR status, checks and reviews and each adapter exposes MergePR; PRs are opened by the agent or an after_run hook, and merging happens only through the opt-in auto_merge reaction (see reactions).

sources.title: Sortie reactions reference
sources.locator: Reaction kinds at a glance; reactions.merge_conflicts; reactions.auto_merge (strategy, require_ci, preconditions, expected head SHA, safety)
sources.finding: auto_merge, off unless provider is set, merges Sortie-created non-draft PRs directly through the SCM adapter when mergeability is clean or unstable, the review decision is APPROVED or not required and CI succeeded (require_ci default true), with strategy merge, squash or rebase and the expected head SHA; merge_conflicts dispatches a rebase-and-resolve continuation turn per conflicting head (not detectable on Gitea); a new head or review decision allows a fresh merge attempt.

sources.title: Sortie bounded feature search
sources.locator: rg -il over cmd internal and the docs content (tests excluded) for: embedding|vector store|semantic search|code index; screenshot|multimodal|image input; living spec|product spec|requirements doc/store; takeover|hand over to human; cpu_ram|NumCPU|loadavg|gopsutil; managed cloud|hosted service|saas|sortie cloud; gallery|recording|artifact upload
sources.finding: No code indexing or retrieval feature, no screenshot or multimodal input handling (matches are the model price table and test fixtures), no product-spec store, no takeover feature, no CPU or memory inspection, no Sortie-hosted service (matches describe hosted GitLab and a dispatch-rule sentence), and no gallery or recording feature.

sources.title: Sortie workflow configuration
sources.locator: workflow-config.md hook examples near lines 505-517 (docker compose up -d supervised services started from a hook)
sources.finding: The hook reference shows hooks starting long-lived services such as docker compose up -d for a run; Sortie itself provides no service or port orchestration.
